whatIs: Liquid Glass Design collects about 190 examples of Apple's translucent Liquid Glass material and of glassmorphism, spread across interface design, art and video. Each piece has its own page and a ready-to-copy style prompt, with Midjourney-style parameters and a list of things to avoid.
It's a good fit when you want to see how the effect looks in different contexts or generate images in a similar style with an AI tool.
uses: Filtering by UI Design and seeing how the glass effect is applied to cards, bars and menus before replicating it in CSS.
Copying a piece's prompt to generate reference images with an AI tool.
Reading the "What is liquid glass?" guide to understand the material before proposing it in a project.
caveats: The examples are reference images and videos: they don't include the CSS code to reproduce them.
The prompt parameters (such as --ar) follow Midjourney syntax and other tools may not understand them.
Results load in batches of 30, and there's a Mobbin sponsorship with a commission on subscriptions.
pricingNote: All the content can be viewed and copied for free.
idealFor: Anyone exploring the liquid glass style or wanting prompts to imitate it.
